title: Giraffes: The Tallest Animals on Earth

segments.text: Hi friends! Today we are visiting the savanna to meet a very tall animal.
[scene: a giraffe walks past acacia trees] Look! That is a giraffe. Giraffes are the tallest animals on land.
A grown-up giraffe can be as tall as three grown-ups standing on each other's shoulders.
Giraffes have a looong neck. Their neck helps them reach leaves high up in the trees.
[scene: close-up of giraffe eating] Giraffes love to eat leaves from the acacia tree. Munch munch munch!
Their tongue is very long too, and it is purple! The dark colour protects it from the sun.
Giraffes have spots. Every giraffe has its own pattern, just like your fingerprints.
[scene: giraffe drinking at a river] To drink water, a giraffe has to spread its legs wide and bend down. That looks tricky!
Giraffes do not drink very often, because the leaves they eat are full of water.
[scene: lion resting in the grass] Uh oh, a lion is nearby. Lions sometimes try to hunt giraffes.
But a giraffe can kick very hard, so the lion usually stays away.
[scene: baby giraffe standing up] Look at this baby giraffe. Baby giraffes can stand up one hour after they are born.
A baby giraffe is already taller than most grown-up people.
Giraffes live in groups called towers. A tower of giraffes, isn't that a fun name?
[scene: giraffes walking at sunset] Giraffes walk slowly, but they can run fast when they need to.
Giraffes sleep only a little bit each day, sometimes standing up.
Here is a question for you: why do you think giraffes have such long necks?
That's right, to reach the highest leaves that other animals cannot reach.
[scene: a red ball rolls past the giraffe enclosure] Whoa, a red ball! The giraffe is looking at it.
Giraffes are curious animals. They like to look at new things.
[scene: zookeeper feeding a giraffe] At the zoo, keepers feed giraffes leaves and special biscuits.
Giraffes are gentle. They rarely fight, except when two boys bump necks to see who is stronger.
[scene: a bird sits on a giraffe's back] Little birds sit on giraffes and eat the bugs off their skin. Everybody wins!
So remember: giraffes are tall, they eat leaves, and their tongues are purple.
Can you stretch up tall like a giraffe? Reach for the sky!
[scene: sunset over the savanna] Thanks for watching with me today. See you next time, friends!
Bye bye!
